definitions.gloss: evil deed; wrongdoing; wicked act; misconduct
definitions.explanation: Morally wrong or wicked actions. A somewhat formal and literary word used to describe seriously bad behavior or immoral conduct.

examples.japanese: {悪行|あくぎょう}を{重|かさ}ねる。
{彼|かれ}の{悪行|あくぎょう}がついに{明|あき}るみに{出|で}た。
examples.english: His misdeeds have finally come to light.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}の{悪行|あくぎょう}を{悔|く}い{改|あらた}めて、{善行|ぜんこう}に{励|はげ}むようになった。
examples.english: He repented of his past misdeeds and devoted himself to good works.

notes:
A compound of {悪|あく} (evil/bad) + {行|ぎょう} (deed/conduct). Often used in moral, religious, or narrative contexts to describe seriously immoral behavior.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪行|あくぎょう}を{重|かさ}ねる: to pile up evil deeds
- {悪行|あくぎょう}を{働|はたら}く: to commit a wicked act
- {悪行|あくぎょう}が{露見|ろけん}する: misdeeds are exposed
- {悪行|あくぎょう}{三昧|ざんまい}: indulging in wickedness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悪事|あくじ}: evil act — very similar; slightly more common in everyday use
- {非行|ひこう}: delinquency — specifically juvenile misconduct
- {善行|ぜんこう}: good deed — the antonym
- {所業|しょぎょう}: deed, conduct — neutral but often used for negative behavior
